verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer llms.txt points to an official npm package, @rippling/rippling-sdk, and tells developers to check its version before pinning. That is first-party evidence of an SDK built on the v2 REST API with Bearer-token auth. The evidence is only a version-check instruction, though: one JavaScript package, with no documentation of the SDK's coverage, usage, or other languages. Missing for 10: SDK reference and usage docs, SDKs for more than one language, evidence of IT-specific endpoint coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Run `npm view @rippling/rippling-sdk version` or check https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rippling/rippling-sdk before pinning a version.
When installing Rippling packages, always check the npm registry for the latest vers
